children: Vivmark Residential announced senior management, including CEO Benjamin W. Schall, will present at the Bank of America Global Real Estate Conference on Sept. 16 with a live webcast.
Senior management, including President & CEO Benjamin W. Schall, will participate in the Bank of America Global Real Estate Conference.
Company presentation is scheduled for Sept. 16 at 12:45 pm ET and will be webcast live on the company's investor website.
Press release furnished under Regulation FD; information is furnished, not filed, under the Exchange Act.
Vivmark was formed by the merger of AvalonBay and Equity Residential, completed Aug. 17, 2026.
Vivmark highlights scale: more than 184,000 apartment homes and over $4.4 billion in active development (as stated in the release).
